note: Independently authored scenario-variety dimensions: general business/marketing categories only. This is OUR own taxonomy for forcing scenario diversity from the input side; it is NOT DECA/MBA Research performance indicators, event blueprints, or any copyrighted DECA material. Each value has a stable `id` (used for the recent-combo signature) and a `label` (the phrase injected into the generation prompt). An event's pool = shared, overlaid with its cluster's overrides, overlaid with the event's own entry; a dimension set to [] is opted out for that event.
